edges: Marcus brings Trina to McTeague's parlor for dental work.
Marcus claims he has been cheated out of money that would have been rightfully his if he had married Trina.
McTeague and Marcus come to grips multiple times, with McTeague's immense physical strength prevailing.
Marcus informs city hall that McTeague has no license or degree, leading to McTeague being debarred from practicing dentistry.
Marcus hears of the murder and joins the hunt for McTeague.
McTeague kills Marcus in a fight over water and Trina's lottery winnings.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: Mrs Sieppe announces that McTeague and Trina are to marry.
